record.one_liner: Customer communication/shared-inbox platform with a REST Core API, Plugin SDK, Channel API, and an official OAuth MCP server.
record.auth_notes: API tokens can be generated directly in Front account settings for single-instance integrations; OAuth2 is recommended for broader/public integrations and is required for apps distributed to all Front customers. All requests use a Bearer token in the Authorization header. The MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 + PKCE.
record.access_notes: Developers can sign up for a free developer environment specifically for building against Front's APIs, no sales contact required. Base API/integration access appears included on all commercial plans; a paid add-on only raises API rate limits.
record.api_breadth_basis: Vendor developer portal lists multiple distinct API surfaces beyond core CRUD: Core API, MCP Server, Connectors, Plugin SDK, Channel API, Chat Widget, and Links, covering conversations, messages, contacts, tags, teammates, and more.
record.blocker_notes: Free developer account grants API and OAuth app credentials without approval; MCP server is open beta with access available to everyone via a self-created OAuth app.
